pages.title: Misery
pages.text: Misery is dark and oppressive, with an eternal deluge of rain that collects in natural circular cisterns. Be very careful of water in this place; once you step in, it will pull you down and you will be unable to surface for air.

The typhlotic beasts of Misery are called $(bold)glooms$(). These jellyfish are sensitive to alchemical currents, and will descend upon you with their stinging tendrils if you have any visible potion effects (effects that are emitting particles).
